name: Mandarin Oriental Guangzhou
insider_take: Soaring above the Pearl River, this ultra-luxe tower puts you at the heart of Guangzhou's financial district with unparalleled views of the city's glittering skyline.
whats_special: Located on floors 28-44 of the International Finance Center, this is one of the highest hotels in Guangzhou. The property features Michelin-starred dining at Jiang by Chef Fei and houses the city's highest spa on the 43rd floor. The hotel's location in Zhujiang New Town places you steps from the iconic Canton Tower and the futuristic Guangzhou Opera House designed by Zaha Hadid.
pro_tip: Book a Pearl River-facing room for sunrise views of the Canton Tower's color-changing LED light show, which illuminates the skyline nightly until midnight.
dont_miss: Take the elevator to the 33rd floor for dinner at Ebony, offering contemporary Cantonese cuisine with panoramic city views. The hotel's direct connection to Zhujiang New Town metro station makes exploring Guangzhou's historic Shamian Island and the vibrant Shangxiajiu pedestrian street effortless.
pros: Premium luxury accommodations with signature Mandarin Oriental service excellence
Prime location in Guangzhou's central business district with skyline views
Award-winning spa and wellness facilities with traditional Asian treatments
Multiple fine dining restaurants featuring Cantonese and international cuisine
cons: Urban setting may lack traditional Chinese cultural ambiance
